title: Storage pools and their health
desc: A view of every storage pool and disk, as in ZimaOS, with RAID or btrfs health, used and free space.

title: Sign in on IceDash's own screen on ZimaOS
desc: On ZimaOS, IceDash still sends you to the ZimaOS dashboard to sign in. It will sign you in on its own screen, as it does on CasaOS.

title: Every system setting in IceDash
desc: Change what the ZimaOS and CasaOS settings offer without leaving IceDash: network, storage, users, shares, the server's name and time zone, system updates, restart and shut down.

title: The official App Store in IceDash
desc: Browse and install apps from the ZimaOS or CasaOS App Store inside IceDash, with the same setup step as IceStore apps.

title: Change an app's settings in IceDash
desc: Edit an installed app's ports, folders and variables in IceDash, instead of opening the stock dashboard for it.

title: Install your own app
desc: Paste a docker-compose file or a docker run command, and IceDash installs it like any other app.

title: Links on the desktop
desc: Add a website or another device, like your router or printer, as an icon on the desktop and in the dock.

title: Restore an app's backup
desc: Put a backup made with Back up data back into its app, from the app's right-click menu.

title: Scheduled app backups
desc: Back up the apps you choose every night to a folder or another disk, and keep the last few.

title: Activity: what each app is using
desc: CPU, memory and network for each app, with the last hour as a graph, so you can see what is keeping the server busy.

title: Edit text files in Files
desc: Open a text or config file in Files, change it and save it, without the Terminal.

title: Files for members
desc: Members get Files too, each with a folder of their own. Today only admins have it.

title: A terminal inside an app
desc: Open a shell in an app's container from its right-click menu. Admins only, like the Terminal.

title: Alerts on your phone
desc: Send IceBell's notifications, like a stopped app, a nearly full disk or a waiting update, to ntfy, Telegram or email.

title: Settings for cards
desc: Let a card keep settings of its own, like the city for the Weather card.

title: Window snapping and remembered windows
desc: Drag a window to an edge to fill half the screen, and each app opens again at the size and place you left it.

title: Theme editor
desc: Pick the colours and wallpaper in Settings, see them live, and save the result as your own theme or export it for a collection.

title: App auto-updates and roll back
desc: Choose which apps update by themselves at night, and go back to an app's previous version if an update breaks it.

title: Export and import IceDash settings
desc: One file with your dock, cards, theme, wallpaper and choices, to move to a new server or recover after a reinstall.

title: Clean up Docker
desc: See how much space unused images and leftover volumes take, and get it back with one button.

title: Arrange icons freely, with folders
desc: Place desktop icons where you like and group apps into folders.

title: Dock options
desc: Put IceDock at the bottom, left or right, choose its size, and let it hide until you need it.

title: Your own app names and icons
desc: Rename an app or give it another icon on your desktop and dock, for you only.

title: Keyboard shortcuts
desc: A page listing every shortcut, with a way to change them.

title: Actions in search
desc: Type "restart Jellyfin" or "stop all" in search to do it, not only to open things.

title: Phone layout and install as an app
desc: A layout made for small screens, and Add to home screen so IceDash opens like an app.

title: Accent colour and text size
desc: Change the accent colour and make text larger or smaller, without installing a theme.

title: Follow the system's light or dark mode
desc: Switch between Ice and Frost by itself, with your device's setting or the time of day.

title: Card sizes and more cards
desc: Small, medium and large cards, and more official ones: calendar, notes, disk temperatures and a site-is-up check.

title: Health checks with auto-restart
desc: Restart an app that stops unexpectedly, and say so in IceBell.

title: Alert rules
desc: Choose when IceBell warns you: disk nearly full, high temperature, high memory.

title: Limits for each app
desc: Cap how much CPU and memory an app may use.

title: Ports overview
desc: One list of every port in use on the server, and which app has it.

title: System logs
desc: The server's own log in a window, with follow and search, like an app's logs.

title: Share links in Files
desc: Make a link to a file or folder that stops working after a time you choose.

title: Zip and unzip in Files
desc: Extract an archive or make one from a selection, right where the files are.

title: Pinned folders in Files
desc: Keep the folders you use most at the top of the Files sidebar.

title: Network shares in Files
desc: Connect an SMB or NFS share from another computer and use it in Files.

title: Activity log
desc: Who installed, removed or changed what, and when the Terminal was opened.

title: Choose what members see
desc: Pick which apps and tools each member gets, so family accounts stay simple.

title: Lock after idle
desc: Ask for the password again after IceDash has been left alone for a while.

title: Remote access status
desc: See and set up remote access, like Tailscale or a Cloudflare tunnel, from IceDash.

title: Cards that can act
desc: Let a card ask for permission to do things, such as restart an app. Today cards can only read.

title: What's new and a first-run tour
desc: Show what changed after an IceDash update, and walk new users through the desktop the first time.

title: A better-looking IceStore
desc: IceStore laid out like the ZimaOS App Store: a Discover page with featured apps, Popular and Most forked rows, new and updated apps and bundles; a sort by newest, last update, stars, forks or name; and new app pages.

title: Update all apps at once
desc: One button in IceStore's Updates list that updates every app waiting there, one after the other.

title: Uninstall from IceStore
desc: An installed app's page in IceStore has an Uninstall button, with the same question about its data as the right-click menu.

title: Only apps your server can run
desc: IceStore hides apps that don't list your server's CPU, with a switch to show them anyway.

title: Change apps from IceDash in ZimaOS
desc: Apps installed by IceDash can be changed in ZimaOS's own app settings. Apps installed before v1.2.0 need one reinstall, keeping their data.

title: App updates on ZimaOS
desc: Updating an IceStore app no longer stops at "ports in use", and keeps the folders you moved or added.

title: Shares connected in ZimaOS show in Files
desc: Shares connected in ZimaOS's Files, like SMB from another server, show under Disks.

title: Folders in setup
desc: Point an app's folders somewhere else, or add one like your media library, before it installs.

title: Other disks in Files
desc: USB sticks, second drives and shares under /media or /mnt show under Disks in the Files sidebar, with how much is free.

title: Easier window buttons
desc: The dots are easier to hit and always show their signs, or switch to Classic − □ × buttons in Settings.

title: °C or °F
desc: Choose the temperature unit in Settings → Appearance. Widgets, like the Weather card, follow it.
